info.name: Employee Dashboard - Auth
info.description:
Role x route verification matrix for the auth layer (requireAuth, requireRole, refresh flow).

How to run:
1. Start the server (`node server.js` in /server) so it's listening on http://localhost:5000.
2. Run folder "1. Register" first, top to bottom — each request saves its tokens into collection variables that the later folders depend on.
3. Then run folders 2, 3, and 4 in any order. Each request has a Postman test assertion on the expected status code, visible in the "Test Results" tab after clicking Send.
4. Re-running "1. Register" is safe — emails are timestamped so they won't collide with previous runs. The registered users are NOT auto-deleted; clean them out of Atlas afterward if you don't want scratch data sitting there (filter by email containing "postman-").
5. You can also select the whole collection and click "Run" (Collection Runner) to fire every request in order in one pass.
